purpose: Manual review of four user-exported fresh Luna V4 captures
procedure: Inspect marked PNG against immutable request, evidence excerpts/boxes, region boxes and final draft. No provider reruns and no prompt/deployment changes in this review.
sceneCounting: Two Gmail attempts belong to one BCG email family; these are three conversation families, not four independent families. Once used to inform a prompt revision, treat them as calibration.
findings: The strongest observed Gmail failure is explicit format/length noncompliance and weak context use. Region boxes select the correct email; one evidence excerpt alone cannot prove which other pixels the model read.
likelyPromptGap: The current prompt specifies broad genre matching and preserves constraints mainly for summaries, but does not explicitly require a contextual full-email frame or supported elaboration for a detailed reply. This is a hypothesis, not causal proof.
nextEvaluation: Compare a generally revised reply/context and format policy against V4 on identical saved inputs, then evaluate independent fresh long-message families. Preserve target separation, language, factual constraints, chronology and commitment checks. Do not require a fixed evidence count or mention every source fact in every short reply.
